key_insight: Large language models can be used to write programs that procedurally construct articulated 3D assets, and Articraft is an agentic system that automates this program-writing to generate diverse articulated models at scale.
problem_solved: Alleviates the scarcity of large, diverse datasets of articulated 3D objects by automating scalable asset creation (including parts, joints, and kinematic structure) so researchers and practitioners can train and evaluate models more effectively.
method: Formulate articulated-asset generation as a program synthesis task: the LLM writes code/programs that assemble parts, define joints, and specify kinematics.
Agentic system (Articraft) provides a programmatic interface and harness to guide the LLM, perform validation/simulation, and iterate on generated programs
Automate variation and scaling by sampling design parameters and verifying constraints (e.g., joint limits, collision checks) to produce large, diverse datasets
impact: Enables rapid, large-scale creation of labeled articulated 3D assets for training perception, reconstruction, and robotics models, reducing reliance on costly manual modeling or limited real-world capture.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: LLM -> program generator (Articraft) -> program execution -> articulated 3D asset

paper_title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation
paper_authors: Matt Zhou, Ruining Li, Xiaoyang Lyu, Zhaomou Song, Zhening Huang
